prompt:

Asset: one transparent player avatar for the existing Ukrainian board-game cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity and clothing reference, Nikita Tsupik. Image 2 is ONLY the established gouache/colored-pencil style, feline anatomy, portrait framing and finish reference. Do not copy image 2's hair, face or hoodie.
Primary request: transform the person in image 1 into a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve his short straight light-brown/dark-blond hair with its short uneven fringe, close-cropped sides, long oval face with a narrow chin, prominent straight fairly thick eyebrows, wide-set light blue-gray eyes, calm straight-on gaze and small closed-mouth neutral smile. Preserve the subtle thin moustache and small patch of chin stubble as faint darker short fur, not a full beard. Anatomy: exactly TWO pointed CAT ears total, on TOP of the head, fully visible. No human ears or extra lower ears. Warm sandy-brown tabby fur, soft cream muzzle and cheeks, muted brown hair matching the photograph.
Clothing: simple black crewneck sweatshirt with relaxed broad shoulders, no hood. Omit all lettering and logos. Fully clothed head-and-upper-torso portrait.
Style: detailed hand-painted warm gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional fur, subtle paper texture on painted areas, warm brown outlines and ivory highlights. Match the existing portrait series.
Composition: square, one centered nearly frontal bust, whole head and ears inside frame with generous transparent margins, naturally rounded shoulder silhouette at the bottom, no hands.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Remove the wall, pipe and all scenery. No background shape, circle, frame, extra people, props, text or watermark.
